newsitem.title: USA: Hibernia to post loan and securities losses.
newsitem.headline: Hibernia to post loan and securities losses.

text.p: Hibernia Corp said Tuesday it expects to post third-quarter earnings of about $0.22 a share, which would include a $15 million negative loan loss provision, and a $5.7 million securities loss and other charges.
The other charges includes asset write-downs related to technological enhancements and additions to reserves for health care benefits and other expenses.
Hibernia said the negative provision reduces loan-loss reserves, reflecting the company's continued strong asset quality.
The company said it anticipates posting third-quarter 1996 earnings of about $0.22 per share on a fully tax-effected basis.
The company reported per-share earnings of $0.29 in the third quarter of 1995, which would have been $0.20 on a fully tax-effected basis.
Hibernia said that in the third quarter it sold about $200 million in securities carred as assets held for sale, resulting in a $5.7 million pre-tax loss.
Proceeds from the sale are to be reinvested into higher-yielding securities and loans, which the company said it hopes will improve future earnings and enhance a net interest margin.
The company said it expects higher earnings to fully offset the loss within 18 months or less.
Third-quarter results are to be released October 15.
